questions.explanation:
Let the coordinates of Q and P be (x1, y1) and (h, k) respectively.

Q lies on x2 = 8y,

x = 8y ....... (1)

Again, P divides OQ internally in the ratio 1 : 3.

or x1 = 4h and

or y1 = 4k

Now putting x1 and y1 in (1) we get,

16h2 = 32k or, h2 = 2k

the locus of P is given by, x2 = 2y.
